role: Reference ground albedos: packed snow, exposed frost soil and cloudy ice.
notes: Original text prompts, no reference images. Requested tileable; shader mirrors and blends samples. Albedo-derived relief is an artistic approximation, not measured physical data.

textures.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original seamless diffuse albedo ground texture for a realistic miniature tabletop tundra. Strict vertical overhead orthographic macro photograph of a 40 centimetre square surface, edge to edge, evenly lit with diffuse neutral light. No directional shadows, highlights, vignette, perspective, depth of field, text, grid or objects. Fine natural irregular detail, tileable edges, no obvious repeated motif. Dense wind-packed snow, fine granular frost crystals and delicate irregular shallow wind-sculpted ridges. Restrained off-white and pale neutral grey, subtle microtexture rather than blank white. No blue lighting, no footprints, no large dunes, no rocks or vegetation, no dark deep cracks. A mostly continuous snow crust with intricate small grains.
